run_catch_policy_gradient: run the catch pytorch policy gradient training with configurable algorithm and episode count
create_policy_gradient_agent: create a policy gradient agent with configurable hidden layers, learning rates, and algorithm type
train_agent_catch_environment: train a policy gradient agent in the open_spiel catch environment for a specified number of episodes
evaluate_policy_agent: evaluate a trained policy gradient agent in the catch environment and return average episode reward
configure_training_flags: configure training flags for num episodes, evaluation frequency, and algorithm selection via absl flags
